obligations.subject: e2
obligations.response: one person shall be on the second row from the rear
obligations.ears: When the rear row of seats has only two seating positions, the laden test weight passenger distribution shall place one person on the second row from the rear.

derived.text: For 2 and 3 seating positions, the laden test weight shall comprise 2 passengers, 2 in the front seats.
For 4 and 5 seating positions, the laden test weight shall comprise 3 passengers, 2 in the front seats 1 in the back seat.
For 6 and 7 seating positions, the laden test weight shall comprise 4 passengers, 2 in the front seats 2 in the rearmost seats.
For 8 and 9 seating positions, the laden test weight shall comprise 5 passengers, 2 in the front seats 3 in the rearmost seats.

obligations.subject: e1
obligations.response: shall be submitted by the vehicle manufacturer or by his duly accredited representative
obligations.ears: The application for approval of a vehicle type with regard to the protection afforded by the bumpers in a collision at low speed shall be submitted by the vehicle manufacturer or by his duly accredited representative.

obligations.subject: e1
obligations.response: shall be accompanied by the undermentioned documents in triplicate and the following particulars
obligations.ears: The application for approval shall be accompanied by the undermentioned documents in triplicate and the following particulars: a detailed description of the vehicle type, drawings of the vehicle, particulars of the vehicle's unladen weight and a detailed description of the protective devices.

derived.text: The application for approval shall be accompanied by a detailed description of the vehicle type with respect to its structure, dimensions, lines and constituent materials.

The application for approval shall be accompanied by drawings of the vehicle showing the vehicle type in front, side and rear elevation and design details of the forward and rear parts of the structure.
The application for approval shall be accompanied by particulars of the vehicle's unladen weight.
The application for approval shall be accompanied by a detailed description of the protective devices: their dimensions, lines, constituent materials and position on the vehicle.

obligations.subject: e7
obligations.response: shall be submitted to the technical service responsible for conducting the approval tests
obligations.ears: A vehicle representative of the type to be approved shall be submitted to the technical service responsible for conducting the approval tests.

obligations.subject: e7
obligations.exception: provided that it can be shown that the absence of the components omitted has no detrimental effect on the results of the test, so far as the requirements of this Regulation are concerned
obligations.ears: When it can be shown that the absence of the components omitted has no detrimental effect on the results of the test, a vehicle not comprising all the components proper to the type may be accepted for test.

obligations.subject: e1
obligations.response: It shall be the responsibility of the applicant for approval to show that acceptance of the variants referred to in paragraph 4.3.1. is compatible with compliance with the requirements of this Regulation
obligations.ears: The applicant for approval shall show that acceptance of the variants referred to in paragraph 4.3.1. is compatible with compliance with the requirements of this Regulation.

obligations.subject: e1
obligations.response: approval of that vehicle type shall be granted
obligations.ears: When the vehicle type submitted for approval pursuant to this Regulation meets the requirements of paragraph 6. below, approval of that vehicle type shall be granted.

obligations.subject: e1
obligations.response: An approval number shall be assigned to each type approved
obligations.ears: An approval number shall be assigned to each type approved.

obligations.subject: e1
obligations.response: first two digits shall indicate the series of amendments incorporating the most recent major technical amendments made to the Regulation at the time of issue of the approval
obligations.ears: The first two digits of the approval number shall indicate the series of amendments incorporating the most recent major technical amendments made to the Regulation at the time of issue of the approval.

obligations.subject: e1
obligations.response: may not assign the same number to another vehicle type
obligations.ears: The same Contracting Party may not assign the same number to another vehicle type.

obligations.subject: e1
obligations.response: shall be communicated to the Parties to the Agreement which apply this Regulation by means of a form conforming to the model in annex 1 to this Regulation and of dimensioned drawings of the vehicle structure supplied by the applicant for approval in a format not exceeding A4 (210 x 297 mm) or folded to that format and on an appropriate scale
obligations.ears: Notice of approval or of refusal of approval of a vehicle type pursuant to this Regulation shall be communicated to the Parties to the Agreement which apply this Regulation by means of a form conforming to the model in annex 1 to this Regulation and of dimensioned drawings of the vehicle structure in a format not exceeding A4 (210 x 297 mm) or folded to that format and on an appropriate scale.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: There shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation an international approval mark
obligations.ears: When a vehicle conforms to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation, an international approval mark consisting of a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval shall be affixed to the vehicle, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle prescribed in paragraph 5.4.1.
obligations.ears: The approval mark shall consist of the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle prescribed in paragraph 5.4.1.

derived.text: Subsequent numbers shall be assigned to other countries in the chronological order in which they ratify or accede to the Agreement, and the numbers thus assigned shall be communicated by the Secretary-General of the United Nations to the Contracting Parties to the Agreement.
The approval mark shall include the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle prescribed in paragraph 5.4.1.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: the Regulation and approval numbers and the additional symbols of all the Regulations under which approval has been granted in the country which has granted approval under this Regulation shall be placed in vertical columns to the right of the symbol prescribed in paragraph 5.4.1.
obligations.ears: When the vehicle conforms to a vehicle type approved under one or more other Regulations annexed to the Agreement in the country which has granted approval under this Regulation, the symbol prescribed in paragraph 5.4.1. need not be repeated and the Regulation and approval numbers and the additional symbols of all the Regulations under which approval has been granted shall be placed in vertical columns to the right of the symbol prescribed in paragraph 5.4.1.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be clearly legible and be indelible
obligations.ears: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and be indelible.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer
obligations.ears: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer.
